gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Audiowide draws every curve and stroke with no swell at all, each glyph sitting like a tile with wide gaps around it. Noto Sans Old Turkic follows in a plain sans, chunky and open.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Generous gaps in the curves make Noto Sans Oriya feel friendly and easy to follow, its small letters nearly as tall as capitals. Almendra Display adds the ornate, literary flourish above.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-osage: Noto Sans Osage fills each line with inflated lowercase bowls and sweeping curves that never close up. And Audiowide, with joins as thick as its strokes, gives the heading a hard, futuristic edge.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-osmany: Ornate and bookish, Almendra Display has a tall x-height and letters that never pinch shut, and it sets the tone fast. Noto Sans Osmanya stays clean beneath, so nudge its size up a little.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hmong: Futuristic and tile-like, Audiowide holds one constant stroke from top to baseline with no thick-thin shift. And Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong, a sans-serif with a high-set x-height, supplies the low-contrast, contemporary counterweight.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-palmyr: Almendra Display never lets its letters pinch shut. Noto Sans Palmyrene, a sans-serif with curves that stop short and compressed ascenders, gives that ornate, literary heading a modern, clean counterpart below.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-hau: Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau is a sans-serif with open-ended curves and lowercase that sits just below the capitals. Audiowide's rounded, cord-like strokes carry the bold lead; the body does the quiet work.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-phagsp: Noto Sans PhagsPa has see-through c openings and a gentle bump up to its capitals, so text feels approachable and smooth. Almendra Display brings ornate, literary character that the sans wisely leaves alone.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Noto Sans Phoenician reads modern and open, with generous lowercase height and s curves that spread wide at both ends. Audiowide handles the futuristic heading punch, while the sans handles sustained reading.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-psalte: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display has a pronounced x-height and letters that never pinch shut, so headings feel crafted. Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi, a plain sans, simply keeps the text approachable.
